en-US.description: A modern, glassmorphic dynamic dock and live widgets for Windows
en-US.longDescription: A lightweight and customizable dock application for Windows with dynamic widgets, glassmorphic design, and real-time system monitoring.
en-US.name: DockHub
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's New in v1.0.0
DockHub 1.0 is here — the unified, glassy dock that replaces your taskbar on Windows and enhances your desktop on macOS. Built with modern native technologies (.NET 10 on Windows, Swift 6 on macOS), DockHub delivers full feature parity across both platforms with zero administrative rights required.

macOS Support (macOS 15 Sequoia)
- Native Swift 6 Architecture: Built from the ground up for macOS 15 using Swift 6 with strict concurrency, AppKit panels, and SwiftUI views.
- Desktop Parity: Floating glass dock, bottom/top/left/right positioning, small/medium/large sizes, transparent backgrounds, and smooth spring animations.
- Dock Replacement or Companion: Option to automatically hide the system Dock while DockHub runs (Settings › General) and restore it on exit, or run side-by-side.
- Mac-Specific Widgets:
  - Calendar: Next meeting from Google Calendar, Outlook, or any iCal (.ics) link with one-click Join for Zoom, Teams, and Meet.
  - Clipboard History: Remembers copied text and images; password managers (org.nspasteboard.ConcealedType) are strictly ignored.
  - Folder Stack: Quick access to Downloads (or any chosen folder) with file drag-out.
  - AirDrop & Shortcuts: Drag files onto the AirDrop icon to share immediately, or trigger Apple Shortcuts with a click.
  - Battery & Bluetooth Devices: Live charge indicators for Mac and connected Bluetooth accessories.
  - Stocks & Currencies: Real-time stock prices (Stooq) and forex/crypto rates (Frankfurter, CoinGecko).
  - To Do: Today's task list (offline or synchronized with Todoist).
  - Screenshots & Ping: Instant screen captures and server latency monitoring.
- Single Settings Schema: Cross-platform config.json configuration compatible between Windows and macOS.
- Multilingual: Full interface localization in English, Turkish, German, and Spanish.

Web Widgets & SDK 1.0
- Custom Widgets with Web Technologies: Develop lightweight widgets using standard HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript.
- window.dockhub API (v2): Secure native bridge supporting settings persistence, key-value storage (256 KB per widget), system notifications, dark/light theme variables, and HTTP requests via host proxy.
- .dockwidget Package Format: Single-file zip archives with verified manifests, entry-point protection, and granular network permissions.
- Widget Gallery: Discover, install, and configure web widgets directly within Settings.

Crash Recovery (.NET 10 on Windows)
- Automatic Crash Recovery: If DockHub closes unexpectedly, Windows restarts it automatically after one minute.
- Loop Prevention: If 3 restarts occur within 10 minutes, DockHub stops safely and restores the standard Windows taskbar with a diagnostic notice.
- Diagnostic Privacy: Safe crash summaries recording module and exception type without personal paths or window titles.
- .NET 10 Runtime: Upgraded to Microsoft .NET 10 with long-term support through November 2028.

Improvements & Fixes
- Global hotkeys support (Carbon on macOS, RegisterHotKey on Windows).
- Multi-profile management with rules for displays, apps, and time intervals.
- Full Undo support (Ctrl+Z / ⌘Z) for dock arrangement and layout modifications.
- Seamless, borderless widget styles and customizable item spacing.
- Continuous integration and automated test suites verifying config schema compatibility and translation completeness.

Download & Installation
- Windows: Download DockHub-Setup-1.0.0-x64.exe (or -arm64.exe for Snapdragon/ARM devices). Installs without admin privileges and auto-updates.
- macOS: Download DockHub-1.0.0.dmg, open the disk image, and drag DockHub to /Applications.

Special Thanks
